body.name: bitsCRE
body.def: \(\ell_{\mathrm{CRE}}\) is the total binary encoding length of \(n\), \(m\), \(a\), the rational value \(\delta\), and the labeled rational partial vector \(y^{\mathrm{obs},\delta}\), when \(\Omega=\mathcal Z_m\) and \(w_z=\binom{n}{m}^{-1}\) are supplied as a succinct completely randomized-design promise rather than as an explicit row list.
